name: Puru Moe Angel Idol Aiko
original_name: ぷる萌えンジェル アイドル・あいこ
source:
Masashi works for a talent agency as a personal secretary. One day, he is ordered to take charge of Aiko, a very popular idol. But he accidentally knows that Aiko is actually a boy...!

[From ErogeShop]
